design_system: QuantCorner / QuantSeras; existing light book layout with optional dark theme
model: G(t) ~ Gamma(t/nu, scale=nu); X(t)=theta G(t)+sigma W(G(t)); unit-mean clock; nu=0 uses deterministic clock limit
status: Hypothetical simulations, not market data or option valuations
preservation: No original Markdown, source snapshot, existing SVG or executed Notebook changed; browser-only sections appended by builder.

validation.numerical: 12 parameter combinations with 200000 samples each; mean within 6 SE, variance within 3.5%, skewness within 0.15; gamma small shape, Normal limit, monotone clock, histogram mass and seeds checked
validation.source: 85/85 blocks and formula markup checked in root pages, export and Notebook
validation.browser: All three labs mounted; sliders, presets, resampling/reset, largest clock step, keyboard chart scrolling; widths 320 and 520 plus desktop; light/dark inspected; no page overflow at 320; finite SVG paths
validation.limitations: Browser controls require JavaScript and HTTP(S); exported site can run from a local HTTP server without network. Histogram bin-center shading approximates tail area; reported probabilities use exact sample thresholds. Gamma sampling uses floating-point arithmetic and discrete observation times.
